#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_turret mp_carentan +set probe_teleport 1 +set probe_pose 1
#   vcod --net-probe 127.0.0.1:28970 --probe-team axis --probe-pitch-flip 85 --probe-secs 70
